name: MGB OIL P
description: Main gearbox oil pressure is below minimum. Voice message "MAIN GEARBOX, LOW PRESSURE".

procedure.text: Reduce power as much as possible. If an immediate safe landing is not possible, reduce power to a minimum for continuation of flight (Vy in level flight) to reach a safe landing site.
Main gearbox dry-run capability has been demonstrated in a bench test (AEO condition) over more than 25 minutes.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.11.3 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
